run_egl_render_loop: run a pybullet simulation loop that renders camera images using the EGL hardware OpenGL renderer plugin
load_egl_plugin: load the eglRendererPlugin into pybullet to enable hardware-accelerated OpenGL rendering on Linux
compute_view_matrix: compute a camera view matrix from yaw, pitch, and roll angles for orbiting around a target position
get_camera_image: get an RGB camera image with depth data from a pybullet simulation using hardware OpenGL rendering
load_urdf_models: load URDF robot and plane models into a pybullet DIRECT mode simulation for rendering
